analysis: Reviewed the supplied base_text excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 1217-2023) plus the patch excerpt. The PR is documentation-only: it bumps the last-updated date, adds KV-floor re-slice text (head ~985-989), and adds cluster health-file text (head ~3532-3540, DARKBLOOM_CLUSTER_MEMBER_HEALTH_FILE, service-health.json versus part-health.json). Other head ranges (5234-5298, 5374-5376) are only partly visible in the truncated patch excerpt. The supplied base units (GLM5Next, calibration, deadlines, MTP, prefix-cache sections) lie outside most changed ranges and are unchanged context, so they show no new behavior. No code, authorization, attestation, encryption or cache-storage control changes appear in the supplied evidence. Relevant threats such as T-041 (prefix cache), T-053 and T-059/T-060 are not modified by what I could see. Remaining uncertainty: the cluster health-file and supervisor PID liveness guard described in the added doc text relate to code not supplied. If the underlying source changed in the same PR, it needs separate review, including the health-file path trust (a same-UID process writing the file), but docs alone do not establish a regression. The truncated patch (head 5234-5298) was not fully visible.
